The '''Vigilant''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Flesh Raider]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] that had been biologically altered to become the living security system for [[CZ-198]], a research facility for [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]], at the orders of [[Special Executive]] [[Rasmus Blys]]. Grown to over half a dozen [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and given extensive [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] enhancements, including hardwiring its brain into the security systems of CZ-198, the Vigilant was installed as the facility's protector.<ref name="Codex" /> However, the Vigilant was ultimately [[Death/Legends|killed]] during an incursion into the facility as CZ-198's power core threatened to explode.<ref name="Meltdown" />
